description: chase-card-offers-* filter offers against YNAB spend using a 90-day window (since_date=$(date -v-90d)). David's example: a Hollywood Feed offer should be added to BCP because they have bought there this year, but a purchase earlier than 90 days ago would not appear and the offer would be skipped.
correction: The YNAB lookback for offer eligibility must cover at least the current calendar year (or 12 months), not 90 days. A merchant bought from at any point this year is a legitimate offer target.
root_cause: 90-day window chosen for recency; too narrow for annual spend patterns.
